entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Jasjit Singh Bedi

Present: Mr. Akbarjit Singh, Advocate, for the petitioners.
 Mr. Shubham Kaushik, Aag, Punjab.
 Mr. Ish Puneet Singh, Advocate, for the complainant.
 ****
Jasjit Singh Bedi, J. (Oral)

The petitioners seek the grant of anticipatory bail under Section 438 Cr.P.C. in case bearing FIR No.0019 dated 26.02.2022 under Sections 406/420/120-B IPC registered at Police Station Navi Baradari, District Jalandhar.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that pursuant to the interim order dated 25.03.2022 passed by this Court, the petitioners have joined the investigation.

The learned State counsel on instructions from ASI Balkaran Singh submits that the petitioners have joined the investigation in terms of the order dated 25.03.2022 and are not required for custodial interrogation.
In view of the above, the interim order dated 25.03.2022 is made absolute.
